_meta.title: Romans — key verses per chapter (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Several curated key verses from each of the 16 chapters of Romans. Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 45 Romans); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: several key verses per chapter (~1-7, scaled to chapter substance)
_meta.keying: book + chapter + citation; multiple records per chapter
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: KJV New Testament renders the divine name as 'Lord'/'God' (no tetragrammaton); text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
verses.plain: I'm not ashamed of the good news about Christ, because it's the power of God that brings salvation to everyone who believes — to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

verses.text: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.
verses.plain: In it, God's way of making us right is revealed — a righteousness that is by faith from start to finish, as it's written: 'The just will live by faith.'

verses.text: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:
verses.plain: Ever since the world was created, God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen in the things he made, so no one has an excuse.

verses.text: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?
verses.plain: Or do you take his rich kindness, patience, and restraint for granted, not realizing that God's kindness is meant to lead you to change your heart?

verses.text: For there is no respect of persons with God.
verses.plain: For God shows no favoritism.

verses.text: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;
verses.plain: For everyone has sinned and falls short of the glory of God.

verses.text: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
verses.plain: and we are made right freely by his grace, through the redemption that came by Christ Jesus.

verses.text: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
verses.plain: So we conclude that a person is made right with God by faith, apart from keeping the law.

verses.text: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
verses.plain: But to the person who doesn't rely on works, but simply trusts the God who makes the ungodly right, their faith is counted as righteousness.

verses.text: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
verses.plain: fully convinced that God was able to do what he had promised.

verses.text: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.plain: So, since we've been made right by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.text: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
verses.plain: And more than that, we can even take pride in our troubles, because we know that trouble produces endurance;

verses.text: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
verses.plain: And this hope will not disappoint us, because God has poured his love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit he gave us.

verses.text: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.plain: But God shows his love for us in this: while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

verses.text: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
verses.plain: So through baptism we were buried with him into death, so that just as Christ was raised from the dead by the glory of the Father, we too can live a brand-new life.

verses.text: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.plain: In the same way, count yourselves dead to sin but alive to God through Christ Jesus.

verses.text: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.plain: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.text: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
verses.plain: What a wretched person I am! Who will rescue me from this body of death?

verses.text: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.
verses.plain: Thanks be to God — through Jesus Christ our Lord! So in my mind I serve God's law, but in my flesh I serve the law of sin.

verses.text: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.plain: So there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.

verses.text: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
verses.plain: I'm convinced that the sufferings of this present time aren't worth comparing with the glory that will be revealed in us.

verses.text: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
verses.plain: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. We don't even know what to pray for as we should, but the Spirit himself prays for us with groans too deep for words.

verses.text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
verses.plain: And we know that God works everything together for good for those who love him, for those he has called according to his purpose.

verses.text: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
verses.plain: So what do we say to all this? If God is for us, who can be against us?

verses.text: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
verses.plain: No — in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

verses.text: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.plain: neither height nor depth nor anything else in all creation will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.text: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.
verses.plain: So it doesn't depend on human desire or effort, but on God's mercy.

verses.text: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
verses.plain: If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

verses.text: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
verses.plain: For everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.

verses.text: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
verses.plain: So faith comes from hearing the message, and the message is heard through the word of God.

verses.text: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
verses.plain: Oh, the depth of the riches and wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable his judgments, and his ways beyond tracing out!

verses.text: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
verses.plain: For from him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory forever. Amen.

verses.text: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
verses.plain: So I urge you, in view of God's mercy, to offer your whole self to God as a living sacrifice — holy and pleasing to him. This is your true and proper worship.

verses.text: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
verses.plain: Don't be shaped by this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so you can discern what God's will is — his good, pleasing, and perfect will.

verses.text: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
verses.plain: Be joyful in hope, patient in trouble, and faithful in prayer.

verses.text: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.plain: Don't be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

verses.text: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
verses.plain: Don't owe anyone anything — except to love one another, for whoever loves others has fulfilled the law.

verses.text: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
verses.plain: Love does no harm to a neighbor; so love is the fulfilling of the law.

verses.text: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.
verses.plain: If we live, we live for the Lord; and if we die, we die for the Lord. So whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.

verses.text: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
verses.plain: For God's kingdom isn't about food and drink, but about righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

verses.text: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
verses.plain: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him, so that you overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

verses.text: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
verses.plain: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
